description: This file contains utility functions for migrating Access Control Lists (ACLs) and policies within the Eclipse Ditto framework. Specifically, it provides methods to convert ACL entries into policies relevant for different schema versions, and defines constants used in this migration process.

classes.name: PoliciesAclMigrations
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods and constants for migrating ACLs and policies between different JSON schema versions within Eclipse Ditto.

methods.name: accessControlListToPolicyEntries
methods.description: Converts an AccessControlList object into a Policy object, assigning permissions based on ACL entries and subject issuers.

methods.name: getSubjectWithoutIssuer
methods.description: Extracts the subject ID from an ACL entry, removing any issuer prefix if present.
